requirement: The hospital patient-record system shall reject any clinical data exchange message whose nonce or sequence counter duplicates one already accepted from the same sending device.
The smart-home IoT controller shall discard any actuator command that carries a timestamp outside the permitted freshness window, so that recorded commands cannot be resent to operate a door lock.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system must detect and refuse a resubmitted salary-change transaction that repeats the unique identifier of an earlier processed transaction.
When a customer's booking session times out, the online booking system shall erase the personal details and payment data entered during that session from all temporary storage.

Once an analyst's forecasting job ends, the sales forecasting system must purge the intermediate customer-level datasets and cached results generated for that job so that later users cannot read them.
After a guest's temporary access grant lapses, the smart-home IoT controller shall wipe the occupancy and routine data it collected about that guest during the grant.
The database server shall return query results only for the tables and rows that the requesting account has been granted permission to read.
The hospital patient-record system must release a patient's medical history only to clinicians who are assigned to that patient's care.
If the simulation software detects tampering with its model files or an unexpected halt caused by hostile input, it shall stop the run and return to a predefined clean configuration.
When the data warehousing system detects that a load job has been disrupted by an intrusion or malicious input, it must abort the job and place the affected tables into a read-only state.
When the smart-home IoT controller detects that its firmware has been interfered with, it shall switch all connected locks and heating devices to preconfigured fallback settings.
The compiler shall refuse remote connections to its build-cache service from any client that is not on the list of approved build agents.
The smart-card electronic purse must prevent card readers that are not approved by the issuer from reading the stored balance and transaction data.
The smart-home IoT controller shall deny wireless network joining to every device that the homeowner has not explicitly approved.
The simulation software shall expose the addresses and capacity of its remote compute nodes only to users holding a simulation-administrator role.
The web browser must prevent web pages from enumerating the hosts and services present on the user's internal network.
The air traffic control software shall show the topology of external radar-feed links solely to authorised controllers and supervisors.
When a technician runs remote diagnostics on the smart-home IoT controller, the controller shall hide residents' presence history and voice recordings from the diagnostic output.
The compiler must remove user names, file paths and source snippets from crash reports before they are made available to support staff.
During maintenance diagnostics, the air traffic control software shall mask the personal identities of crew and passengers in any data shown to the maintenance engineer.

domain: payroll and human resources management system
requirement: The payroll and human resources management system shall block inbound traffic from the internet that is not a reply to a connection started from inside the internal network.
The online booking system must drop unsolicited incoming packets that do not belong to an established session, so that port scans and flooding attempts do not reach its application servers.
The online banking application shall track the state of every network connection to its back-end and discard packets that do not match a legitimate ongoing exchange.
The database server shall let an administrator run a check that detects whether any stored record has been altered since it was last written by an authorised process.
The compiler must verify, before linking, that each cached object file matches the checksum recorded when it was produced and reject any file that differs.
The hospital patient-record system shall allow auditors to confirm that archived medical records are identical to the versions originally saved.

The online booking system shall allow a travel agency employee to sign a group reservation on behalf of the agency using a private signing key that is kept hidden from all other users, so that any later change to the reservation is detectable.

The compiler must sign each release build on behalf of the development team with a private key that is never disclosed to individual developers, so that any modification of the binary invalidates the signature.

The hospital patient-record system shall let a physician sign a discharge summary for the care team with a private key accessible only to that physician, so that alteration of the summary is detectable.
The web browser shall check embedded ownership marks in downloaded images and flag any image whose mark has been removed or changed.
The compiler must detect when the same embedded provenance mark appears in sources submitted by different contributors and report the conflicting submissions.
The smart-home IoT controller shall verify the embedded ownership mark of each firmware image offered by different vendors and reject any image whose mark has been modified.
The compiler shall check each imported library for an embedded origin mark and report to the developer whether the mark proves the declared publisher.
The sales forecasting system must inform the analyst, for each imported dataset, whether it carries a verifiable source stamp that confirms the identity of the data provider.
